facts.fact: StackAdapt was recognized by the Independent Media Agencies of Australia (IMAA) as Digital Partner of the Year in its annual survey of more than 160 independent media agencies in Australia.
facts.quote: recognized by the Independent Media Agencies of Australia (IMAA) as Digital Partner of the Year in their annual survey of more than 160 independent media agencies in Australia.

facts.fact: The awards ceremony took place in Sydney in late November 2024 with over 250 independent media agency leaders and media partners in attendance.
facts.quote: The awards ceremony took place in Sydney in late November with over 250 independent media agency leaders and media partners in attendance.

facts.fact: StackAdapt secured the IMAA Digital Partner of the Year award after only three years of entering the Australian market, according to the company's VP APAC.
facts.quote: StackAdapt secured the award after only three years of entering the intensely competitive Australian market.

facts.fact: IMAA judges agency survey responses on criteria including service, proactivity, value proposition, data and insights, innovation, and effectiveness, and each member votes for the partner providing the greatest value.
facts.quote: are judged on criteria of service, proactivity, value proposition, data and insights, innovation, and effectiveness.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as the #1 DSP and a Top 100 Software Product on G2 (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: StackAdapt is the [#1 DSP](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) and a Top 100 Software Product on G2

facts.fact: StackAdapt won the IMAA award for Best Media Vendor the previous year (2023).
facts.quote: Last year StackAdapt won the [IMAA award for Best Media Vendor]
